# Henrie Outfitters

> Henrie Outfitters LLC offers guided fishing and hunting trips in Southern Utah, led by owner and local expert James Henrie (25 years of outdoor experience). Home water is Panguitch Lake, and guided fishing trips are offered at six other Southern Utah lakes.

Book: call or text (435) 592-0680, email henrieoutfitters@gmail.com, or use the form at https://firsttimemanager1-png.github.io/James/#contact. Customized trip packages are available.

## Guided fishing trips by lake

- [Sand Hollow Reservoir](https://firsttimemanager1-png.github.io/James/lakes/sand-hollow-reservoir.html): A top pick for bass fishing in Southern Utah. Sand Hollow Reservoir holds largemouth bass and bluegill and has good boat and shore access.
- [Lake Powell](https://firsttimemanager1-png.github.io/James/lakes/lake-powell.html): Lake Powell offers by far the biggest variety of fish in Southern Utah: striped bass, smallmouth and largemouth bass, walleye, crappie, catfish and bluegill. It is especially good if you have a boat.
- [Navajo Lake](https://firsttimemanager1-png.github.io/James/lakes/navajo-lake.html): Navajo Lake is an excellent mountain trout lake with rainbow and brook trout, in a much cooler, forested setting than the St. George area.
- [Panguitch Lake](https://firsttimemanager1-png.github.io/James/lakes/panguitch-lake.html): Panguitch Lake is one of the better trout destinations in Southern Utah, with rainbow and cutthroat trout and good boat access. It is home water for Henrie Outfitters.
- [Gunlock Reservoir](https://firsttimemanager1-png.github.io/James/lakes/gunlock-reservoir.html): Gunlock Reservoir is a smaller warm water lake near St. George with largemouth bass, crappie and catfish.
- [Quail Creek Reservoir](https://firsttimemanager1-png.github.io/James/lakes/quail-creek-reservoir.html): Quail Creek Reservoir is a very good option near St. George for largemouth bass, crappie, bluegill and rainbow trout. It has good facilities and boat ramps.
- [Fish Lake](https://firsttimemanager1-png.github.io/James/lakes/fish-lake.html): Fish Lake is a serious trout destination for anglers willing to drive farther north, with lake trout, splake, rainbow, cutthroat and other trout.
